Direction: map story

Static mockup. Every number, name and quote is copied from the live API on port 8812 (/api/answer, /api/trip) for the same queries, or from src/vf/why_not.py, questions.py and public_list.py run on those queries (they are not wired into /api/answer yet). Open a frame alone with #landing, #lucknow, #sim-lucknow, #sim-jaipur, #sim-jokihat, #expanded, #jokihat, #jaipur, #p-lucknow, #p-sim, #p-jokihat. Simulator counters are computed by sim.py (the browser's rules, in Python) from the /api/trip payload: real coordinates and evidence status, the D048 drive-time model and the service windows in src/vf/services.py.

Which hospital can actually help, and how do we know?

Pick the care and the patient's place. We show up to 3 facilities, quote their own records, and say plainly when nothing reliable is near.

  1. Pick the care 12 kinds, or type your own
  2. Type the place PIN, village, town or district
  3. Read the answer nearest with evidence, what to ask on the phone

Try an example

  • Dialysis near Jaipur
  • Emergency C-section at PIN 226001, Lucknow
  • Dialysis from Jokihat, rural Bihar
  • High-risk delivery in Nashik
  • Trauma care near Kotputli on NH48

Why not the nearer ones?

4 places are nearer than BNK Hospital. We found no fact naming C-section in any of their records.

  • Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Civil Chikitsalay public hospital · 0.8 km

    Public hospital: we found no fact naming caesarean section among its 6 facts. Public hospitals are often thinly described online, so this silence is not evidence either way.

  • Balrampur Hospital public hospital · 2.0 km

    Public hospital: its record lists obstetrics and gynaecology as a specialty, but we found no fact naming caesarean section among its 62 facts. That silence is not evidence either way; ask the hospital.

Rule 2: Each patient heads for the nearest place that lists C-section, whatever its record shows. If that place shows no evidence of C-section, the patient goes on to the nearest place whose record shows it: the cost if that place cannot help.

Each moving dot is a patient from a village (post office area) within 50 km. No route is drawn in advance: each dot picks its target by the rule, and picks again if the map changes.
